accounting.settlement: Record provider-native quantities after execution; do not translate them into money unless an independent cost oracle supplies the rate.

retentionPolicies.ephemeral: Destroy the exact notebook after locally seating purchased outcomes and a cleanup intent.
retentionPolicies.persistent: Retain the notebook until an authorized custodian purchases an exact destruction operation.

authority.creation: A purchased workspace offer does not create Leader authority. Live opening also requires a current exact notebook-creation authorization.
authority.custody: The accepted lease assigns operation custody only to its customer actor.
authority.advice: Notebook answers and Studio outputs are non-authoritative knowledge artifacts.
authority.promotion: Union Advisory admission is a separate assay and is never implied by condensation.
